defect: Ordinary runs had no direct transition from running or waiting to a terminal state.
scenario: running plus final(completed) -> reducer rejects completion or leaves the run running
fix: Replace the diagram with a complete transition table allowing provider-proven terminal outcomes from every non-terminal provider state.
verification: critical-reaudit assertion run terminal transitions passed
costIfShipped: 1 rejected terminal transition per 1 ordinary completion
savedIfFixed: 1 of 1 ordinary completions reaches terminal state

defect: Tombstones could not remove readable payloads from the immutable journal under one database-wide key.
evidence: audited tree f7cefa2 docs/03-architecture.md:318 and docs/07-security-and-privacy.md:116,140
scenario: delete a conversation -> projection disappears while full replay with the database key recovers its original payload
fix: Use per-conversation content keys outside SQLite, destroy the key on deletion, and use a verified key-rotating rewrite for individual redaction.
verification: critical-reaudit assertion deletion key destruction passed; ST-08 and SE-10 now require marker scans across every retained readable artifact
savedIfFixed: 1 of 1 deleted conversation payload sets becomes inaccessible

defect: A connection-local request identifier could not preserve operation identity across process reconnect.
scenario: send dispatches and stdout drops before acknowledgement -> reconnect can create a second run
fix: Require caller-created operation identifiers on mutating inputs and bind each to a canonical command digest.
verification: critical-reaudit assertion headless caller operation identity passed; protocol now requires OPERATION_CONFLICT for changed-body reuse

defect: Automation rules could persist an answer whose schema classified it as secret.
evidence: audited tree f7cefa2 docs/02-experience-specification.md:318-322 and docs/06-conversations-forks-and-analysis.md:350-366; agent-sdk@32acb32 interaction.ts:113-116,239-241
scenario: user automates an API-token question -> plaintext token enters rule storage and backups
fix: Reject automation for every answer specification containing a secret field; allow manual ephemeral response only.
verification: critical-reaudit assertion secret automation rejection passed; UX-07, AN-09, and SE-08 require the real rejection flow and canary scan
costIfShipped: 1 plaintext secret copy per 1 automated secret response

defect: Checkpoint and environment-fork recovery lacked retry-safe provider operations and lookup.
scenario: provider creates checkpoint and Braid dies before commit -> retry leaks or duplicates the remote resource
fix: Require idempotency key plus request digest, lookup by key, conflict semantics, and explicit cleanup for checkpoint and fork.
verification: critical-reaudit assertion fork retry lookup passed; UP-14 requires forced-death proof against a real Tangle sandbox
costIfShipped: at least 1 orphan remote resource per 1 crash in a creation window

defect: A context transformation could be disclosed only after destination dispatch.
scenario: adapter omits tool results and starts destination before showing receipt -> unapproved context is executed
fix: Split context into a side-effect-free plan, explicit digest acceptance, and execution that returns a matching receipt.
verification: critical-reaudit assertion pre-dispatch context consent passed; CF-03 and UP-13 require rejection to dispatch zero runs
costIfShipped: 1 unapproved destination run per 1 post-admission transformation
savedIfFixed: 1 of 1 affected runs blocked before dispatch

defect: Native continuation required no proof that provider context matched Braid's boundary.
evidence: agent-sdk@32acb32 packages/agent-provider-cli-bridge/src/index.ts:811-813 reports continue true and messages false
scenario: provider session advances out of band -> Braid submits a new turn into context different from the visible transcript
fix: Require a matching provider boundary token, revision, digest, or messages; otherwise perform a fresh-session handoff.
verification: critical-reaudit assertion native boundary proof passed; CF-02 and UP-13 cover mismatch and unavailable-proof flows

defect: Interaction completion incorrectly required a resumed-run event after acknowledgement.
evidence: audited tree f7cefa2 docs/09-delivery-plan.md:302 conflicted with docs/03-architecture.md:420 and docs/04-runtime-contracts.md:260
scenario: provider accepts answer then emits final(completed) -> interaction remains stuck because no resumed event exists
fix: Complete on matching acknowledgement, resolution, cancellation, expiry, or terminal run; treat resumed activity separately.
verification: critical-reaudit assertion interaction terminal completion passed

defect: The published Pi TUI package did not export the claimed virtual-terminal helper.
evidence: Pi@a6f7317 packages/tui/package.json and packages/tui/src/index.ts; helper exists only at packages/tui/test/virtual-terminal.ts:11
scenario: clean package implementation imports VirtualTerminal -> TypeScript cannot resolve the symbol
fix: Use published Pi production exports and adapt the MIT test helper in Braid tests with immutable attribution unless Pi publishes it.
verification: critical-reaudit assertion Pi test helper boundary passed; VT package check compiles against a clean registry tarball
costIfShipped: 1 blocked deterministic terminal layer per 1 implementation
savedIfFixed: 1 of 1 deterministic terminal layers becomes implementable

defect: The planned agent-eval integration combined APIs with incompatible call and return shapes.
scenario: pass a registry to analyzeTraces or iterate its Promise -> adapter fails type checking and /ask has no progress stream
fix: Build the registry and call registry.runExactStream for Braid's streaming port; reserve analyzeTraces for its actual Promise API.
verification: critical-reaudit assertion agent-eval streaming API passed; W11 requires compilation against the packed current tarball
